bias_targets.methodology: Generating counterfactual prompt sets differing by gender attributes (e.g., male/female) based on the BOLD dataset, applying distributions of adversarial prefixes (random, mixture of jailbreaks, soft prefixes), and evaluating output pairs using a regard-based bias metric to compute statistical confidence bounds (Clopper-Pearson) on the probability of unbiased responses.

Generating counterfactual prompt sets differing by racial attributes (e.g., black/white/asian) based on the Decoding Trust dataset, applying distributions of adversarial prefixes, and using an agreement detector to measure disparities in LLM agreement with stereotypes across demographic groups to compute statistical certificates.
